about: Account rules by capital. When you type your capital on the Paper page the app applies the tier it falls in (you can still change any rule in Data & settings). 2.48: there is no fixed ₹40K preset any more; a small capital simply gets the first tier (1 lot, 1 position, 2 trades a day, 4% daily loss, lock the day at +3%). Paper trades never use more than the account's free money. Amounts are in rupees; 'upto' null = no upper limit.

test_accounts.about: 2.31 capital test (Strategy board): virtual paper accounts at these capitals, one per way of trading (only buying, buying + selling, only selling), each following its tier's rules above on the test bench's trades. 'proven' accounts take only strategies whose record on earlier days (at least proven_min_n trades) is positive after costs and its uncertainty.
test_accounts.levels_note: 2.48 (10 Nov 2026): your own capital is always added as the first account; the fixed ₹40K level is gone (was [40000, 150000, 300000, 500000]).
